idea-plugin.name: Gruvbox Islands - Theme
idea-plugin.description: An Islands-native edition of the Gruvbox theme for JetBrains IDEs 2025.3 and later. This plugin is a fork of the existing Gruvbox - Theme plugin, adapted for the Islands UI. gruvbox is heavily inspired by badwolf, jellybeans and solarized. Designed as a bright theme with pastel 'retro groove' colors and light/dark mode switching in the way of solarized. The main focus when developing gruvbox is to keep colors easily distinguishable, contrast enough and still pleasant for the eyes. Includes dark and light themes in hard, medium, and soft contrast variants.
